_comment: OWNER: M4. F16 Story Mode script. Based on 36h Plan Section 8.1 pitch cut (~4 minutes). Every entry maps to a page the Streamlit app can navigate to. Page targets use the Streamlit page names as shown in the sidebar.

slides.callout: Credit gap: ₹25 lakh crore to ₹60 trillion – viable firms are invisible to lenders. Meet Meena, a women-led textile unit with strong cash flow but no bureau score.
Legacy system rejects Meena: thin file. Our cockpit gives her a calibrated probability of default, three plain reasons, and a data-confidence score.
Wow #1: move the receivable-days slider. The decision flips live. Meena sees her route to approval and exactly how many months it takes.
Wow #2: Meena's own screen. Plain language, no jargon. Download her letter in Tamil. Watch the 6-month journey curve cross the approval line.

Portfolio scoreboard at equal loss rate. Move the inclusion-floor slider: approved count changes, and you see the price of inclusion in ₹. Fairness has a measurable cost – and it is surprisingly small.
Wow #3: click 'Demonetisation-style shock'. Contagion ripples through the supplier graph. Expected loss rises; the mitigation lever cuts it back.
After disbursal we flag trouble months before it becomes a default. Median lead time is shown on the watchlist.
FREE-AI map, decision ledger, gaming toggle (10 s), honest limits. We did not build a better score – we built a decision that a borrower, an officer and a regulator can each trust.

guided_tour.tip: Start here. See Meena's profile and the system-status badge. All results come from precomputed artifacts – no live training.
Select Meena (MSME-00001). Note the PD gauge, three reasons and the recourse card. Move a lever slider to see the decision flip.
This is what Meena sees: plain language, her journey curve, and a multilingual letter download.
Move the inclusion-floor slider and watch the approved count and the price of inclusion in ₹ change in real time.
Every decision is logged. The FREE-AI map shows which obligations we map to. Use the gaming toggle to see robustness.
